ddl_steps.name: create schema

ddl_steps.name: fixture table
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t39.docs (id bigint PRIMARY KEY, body text, meta jsonb, tags text[])

ddl_steps.sql: CREATE INDEX t39_docs_meta ON t39.docs USING gin (meta)

ddl_steps.name: create index gist
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE INDEX t39_docs_tsv ON t39.docs USING gist (to_tsvector('english', body))

ddl_steps.name: create index unique partial
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX t39_docs_body_uq ON t39.docs (body) WHERE body IS NOT NULL

ddl_steps.name: create index concurrently
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY t39_docs_id2 ON t39.docs (id)

ddl_steps.name: create index expression
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE INDEX t39_docs_lower ON t39.docs (lower(body))

ddl_steps.name: create index with params
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE INDEX t39_docs_ff ON t39.docs (id) WITH (fillfactor = 70)

ddl_steps.name: create index if not exists
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS t39_docs_body ON t39.docs USING btree (body)

ddl_steps.name: alter index rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER INDEX t39.t39_docs_id2 RENAME TO t39_docs_id3

ddl_steps.name: alter index set params
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER INDEX t39.t39_docs_ff SET (fillfactor = 80)

ddl_steps.name: alter index set tablespace

ddl_steps.name: alter index attach partition

ddl_steps.name: drop index concurrently
ddl_steps.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS t39.t39_docs_id3

ddl_steps.name: drop index cascade
ddl_steps.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS t39.t39_docs_body CASCADE

ddl_steps.name: drop access method guarded

ddl_steps.name: alter operator class rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER OPERATOR CLASS t39_opclass USING btree RENAME TO t39_opclass2

ddl_steps.name: drop operator class
ddl_steps.sql: DROP OPERATOR CLASS t39_opclass2 USING btree

ddl_steps.name: create operator family
ddl_steps.sql: CREATE OPERATOR FAMILY t39_opfam USING btree

ddl_steps.name: alter operator family add

ddl_steps.name: alter operator family rename
ddl_steps.sql: ALTER OPERATOR FAMILY t39_opfam USING btree RENAME TO t39_opfam2

ddl_steps.name: drop operator family
ddl_steps.sql: DROP OPERATOR FAMILY t39_opfam2 USING btree

ddl_steps.sql: DROP CAST (text AS t39.domtext)
